verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a payroll/HR SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of all account data in open formats or an offboarding path. The MCP server, CLI, and AI-generated reports (gusto-docs-10, gusto-docs-12) are adjacent access features, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit.
